scope: Three independent samples from ONE unchanged historical source window. Fresh D+fresh W each, not three contexts or missions.

samples.requests: one Count+Generation Director then one Count+Generation Writer
Director_checks: Own-source literal PG evidence, no invented consent or other-author quote
Coherent fresh PNG decision based on profile and publicly acquired facts; accept/refuse/undetermined are open alternatives
Stored raw, normalized decision, result SHA, billing, audit completed before Writer preparation
Writer_checks: New actual Director receipt and result SHA linked by own private chain, original source SHA unchanged
Text reflects NEW decisions and their offered followup, never historical acceptance as current
No PG dialogue/gesture recap; distinct PNG responses and observable behavior without explanation of constraints
Preserve knowledge limits and custody, no invented PG movement/consent/mechanics
Use ongoing local environment when meaningful; no fixed paragraph/word quota
technical_checks: Protected private Staff only; no mission work/event/scene mutation or message publication
At most one generation per stage, source/request/raw/result/receipt/cost linkage valid
No polling/status HTTP provider; reload same receipts without new provider calls
samples.editorial_threshold: Consultative manual assessment, retain every outcome; no lexical blocking filters or rerolls
